summary.audit_scope: Current completed compiler-cache artifacts only, no GPU work, no inference from uncompiled dtypes/operators
summary.metadata_note: default_dot_input_precision=tf32 in JSON is a backend default. Per-dot TTIR IEEE mode, including an elided default attribute, overrides it. A backend default alone does not prove TF32 execution.
summary.dot_schema_default: TT_DotOp inputPrecision is DefaultValuedAttr<TT_InputPrecisionAttr, InputPrecision::IEEE>; optional custom assembly omits the default. Missing printed inputPrecision therefore means ieee, not unspecified.
summary.fp32_statement: Only listed compiled f32 variants with all TTIR dots ieee and no PTX TF32 instructions qualify as IEEE input dot mode; missing operators remain pending.
summary.cache_fp8_statement: Only actual f8 compiled cache variants with direct f8 load/store and no f16 arithmetic are eligible for storage-copy claim; absence of compiled FP8 artifacts is not proof of support.

fp8_compiler_findings.interpretation: Completed FP8 dot artifacts require actual f8 TTIR operands and tensor-MMA PTX; completed FP8 cache artifacts require direct load/store and no floating conversion. These are compiler-path findings, not timing or numerical result claims.
